name: Gearbox
text: Add Elements to Video as a skill to EXCAVA’s toolkit. This lets us insert new visual elements into existing footage without rebuilding scenes from scratch, saving time and preserving the high-quality source material we already have. The trade-off is that some elements may not blend perfectly with the original lighting or perspective, but the speed gain outweighs minor visual inconsistencies for most use cases.
